description: This file contains unit tests for the MacGatewayChatTransport class in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing mapping functions between different event representations and snapshot data structures used within the chat transport layer.

methods.name: snapshot maps to health
methods.description: Tests that a snapshot event maps correctly to a health state in the transport layer.

methods.name: health event maps to health
methods.description: Tests that a health event payload maps correctly to a health state.

methods.name: tick event maps to tick
methods.description: Verifies that a tick event is mapped appropriately.

methods.name: chat event maps to chat
methods.description: Verifies proper mapping of chat events with specific payload details.

methods.name: unknown event maps to nil
methods.description: Ensures that unknown events do not produce a mapping.

methods.name: seq gap maps to seq gap
methods.description: Checks that sequence gap events are correctly identified.
